id: title:dmarchuk:emit the versioned email tracking code

review.posthog_relevance: Adds workflow version attribution to SES email tracking invocations and their signed payloads, enabling PostHog to distinguish opens and clicks by the workflow version that sent the email rather than the version active at webhook receipt.
review.reason: The change adds workflowVersion to SES tracking invocations and their signed payloads, and includes marker assertions. This supports PostHog's SES email delivery and attribution workflow, allowing the system to correctly attribute opens and clicks to the specific workflow version that generated the email, rather than the version active when the webhook arrives. This is a bounded, P
